versions.content: If the parameter ComTxIPduClearUpdateBit of an I-PDU is configured to Confirmation, the AUTOSAR COM module shall clear all update-bits of all contained signals and signal groups after this I-PDU was sent out via PduR_ComTransmit, PduR_ComTransmit returned E_OK and the I-PDU was suc- cessfully confirmed.
